bodyStall.scope: Actual shared helper + actual safe-network transport, only the header budget shortened for this fixture. Native loopback headers and partial chunk never complete. External fixture shutdown cleans only its sockets.

fileOpenFailure.scope: Controlled response stream plus actual own-directory open failure. No real URL contacted.

limitations: No download to a public endpoint, native engine or Windows service launched.
320 ms with a controlled 60 ms header budget is a transport-phase invariant test, not a 60-second production outage.
Maximum disk exhaustion and archive expansion were not exercised.
